newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT says first qtr op profit rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT says first qtr op profit rises.

text.p: Transport group TNT Ltd said on Wednesday its operating profit in the first quarter to September 30 was A$27.0 million, up 14.7 percent on the year ago quarter.
TNT chairman Fred Millar also told shareholders at the annual meeting that the after tax profit had more than doubled to A$27.87 million from A$11.99 million a year ago.
Dutch postal and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) last month launched an agreed A$2.0 billion agreed bid for TNT, pitched at A$2.45 a share.
KPN said on Tuesday it has increased its stake to 19.2 per cent. The offer closes on November 19.
TNT shares were unchanged A$2.43 in early trading on Wednesday.
